semantic_correction.calculation: Current issuer-reported XRP holdings minus prior trading-day issuer-reported XRP holdings, with absolute changes below 100 XRP set to zero.
non_creation_components_counted_as_flow: BITW index rebalancing can change its XRP sleeve holdings.
Fee accrual paid in XRP can reduce reported holdings.
semantic_correction.interpretation: The publisher's holdings delta is a useful secondary holdings-change proxy, but it is not a pure subscription/redemption measure for every fund or date. It must not be interpreted as spot XRP buying pressure without fund-specific and component-level qualification.

gxrp.effect: Holdings were frozen during the capture gap and a catch-up appeared on 2026-09-28. The publisher withholds GXRP flow for the full history while retaining GXRP holdings and AUM in totals.

reconstructed_rows.method: Third-party daily flow estimates chained between issuer-reported anchor days.
reconstructed_rows.limitation: Cumulative change between anchors may reconcile while the day-by-day allocation remains an estimate; do not use reconstructed daily changes as primary event-time observations.

settlement.rule: Issuer holdings files can publish overnight or the next morning. The latest row can be provisional and rewritten after settlement; data_as_of identifies the latest settled row.
settlement.leakage_control: A historical feature query must use the time the relevant issuer file became available, not merely the ETF session date.

usd_valuation.rule: USD flow uses the publisher's XRP reference price for the row; where no spot snapshot exists, NAV-implied median net-assets/holdings price is used.
usd_valuation.limitation: Do not treat NAV-implied values as independently observed spot prices.

data_quality_exceptions.coverage_start: 2025-12-01; earlier launch-period estimates are hand-entered and not included in the published dataset.

xrp_insights.scope: Six US spot funds plus BITW holdings; GXRP flow withheld; fund-level status and capture-gap rules apply.

cryptokeyhole.nov6_coverage: 3 of 4 daily-readable funds; Franklin XRPZ missing
cryptokeyhole.caveat: Different daily-readable fund universe and issuer-file timing. Its Nov 6 partial value is not a complete all-fund total.

alpha_finance.caveat: Different five-fund universe and USD reporting. Do not force equivalence with XRP-denominated holdings-delta totals.

cross_publisher_reconciliation.source_independence: XRP Insights, CryptoKeyhole and Alpha Finance are separate publishers but rely on overlapping issuer holdings information and/or derived holdings deltas. Their outputs are not independent confirmations of net primary-market subscriptions.

source_receipts.hash_scope: SHA-256 of normalized observation excerpt assembled from the rendered methodology and machine-readable metadata; not raw HTTP wire bytes, headers, the full JSON dataset, or issuer source files.
source_receipts.normalized_excerpt:
XRP Insights ETF data page, accessed 2026-11-08:
Dataset generated_at 2026-11-08T08:47:49.641Z; data_as_of 2026-11-06; 231 trading days; 1,597 fund-day rows; 7 tickers.
Nov 2–Nov 6, 2026 net flow: −812,529 XRP; Nov 6 total holdings: 1,195,787,657 XRP.
Methodology: daily flow is the change in issuer-reported XRP holdings versus the previous trading day; changes under 100 XRP are treated as zero.
GXRP flows are withheld because issuer-page access was blocked 2026-09-02 through 2026-09-28; holdings froze and the catch-up landed on 2026-09-28. GXRP holdings and AUM remain in totals.
Rows from 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-27, 2026-03-31 to 2026-04-29, and 2026-05-12 were reconstructed from third-party daily flow estimates between issuer-reported anchors; the daily split is an estimate.
Issuer files publish overnight or next morning; latest rows can be provisional and rewritten after settlement. data_as_of is the latest settled row.
Changes caused by BITW index rebalancing or fee accrual paid in XRP are counted as flow, even though they are not necessarily creations/redemptions.
USD price values use stored spot snapshots where available and NAV-implied median prices when absent; no spot snapshot was stored for 2025-12-24 through 2026-04-14.
Source: https://xrp-insights.com/data and https://xrp-insights.com/data/xrp-etf-flows.json

licensing.action: Store only the normalized factual excerpt and provenance receipt in this research artifact; do not copy the full CSV/JSON dataset into the repository.

model_admission.reason: Secondary holdings-delta proxy; not pure subscriptions/redemptions; reconstructed rows, capture gaps, provisional settlement, fund-universe differences and non-creation components must be represented before any feature admission.
model_admission.future_policy: If admitted later, retain as a flagged issuer-reported holdings-delta proxy with point-in-time availability, per-fund coverage, row_status and reconstruction flags. Never relabel it as direct ETF net creations/redemptions.
